rows.What You Will Pay.Out-of-Network Provide: Same as in-network pharmacy, plus you pay excess over our in-network drug cost
rows.Limitations, Exceptions, & Other Importa: Maximum day supply per fill is 30 days at retail, 90 days through mail order. 90-day supplies are available at a participating Extended Day Supply (EDS) network pharmacy or through mail order. You pay in full at an Out-of-Network Retail pharmacy and can submit for reimbursement. Brand name when generic available - same as generic drugs, plus the difference in cost of generic and brand name.
